authorization: User chose 6500 Hanzi (TGH2013 levels 1/2), plus English/digits/common punctuation and symbols. Retain 22px/2bpp; reduce coverage without enabling font compression. No new device window.

charset_source.property: kTGH, year 2013, consecutive unique indices 1..6500 from complete 1..8105 mapping

font_profile.supplemental_limit: Candidate Latin/punctuation/symbol ranges are intersected with source cmap; 987 candidate non-Hanzi codepoints are unsupported. No promise of complete Unicode ranges.
font_profile.export_range: 0x20-0x2ffff, with actual coverage constrained by subset TTF
font_profile.fallback: NULL; existing LVGL placeholder used for unsupported glyphs, message bytes unchanged

generation.scope: Message TTF only; fixed UI/icons/images preserved. Generated C changed only via official Editor.
generation.official_gui_result: Ctrl+B in the main checkout XML project; observed Code generated successfully and Project compiled successfully. Notification detail preview rendered with the new font.
generation.preview_scale: GUI observed at 90%; exact 390x450 host snapshots independently inspected at native size. No claim of GUI 100% capture.

host_validation.build_command: cmake --build artifacts/host-ui-build --target notifications_ui weather_ui settings_ui product_ui component_editor aod_ui -j 4
host_validation.export_checks: C runtime checks all 6500 listed Hanzi are real glyphs, including three supplementary-plane entries; plain 2bpp and explicit exclusions use placeholder. Line height <=34.
host_validation.visual_limit: Not pixel-identical. In an 18-unique-character ordinary notification sample, 起/记/笔/。 have changed exported raster/box height/vertical offset; other 14 glyph rasters and metrics identical. All advances unchanged, line_height31/base_line7 unchanged. Selected source TTF outlines and hmetrics identical. Internal rerasterization cause not determined; these four glyphs are not claimed to explain every frame difference.

source_review: Read-only Luna/low located affected consumers/tests. Sol/medium independently verified the complete ordered Unicode list, TTF/C cmap scope, generation boundary, plain format and sample raster differences. Primary owns edits/builds/Git/acceptance. No unresolved source blocker identified.
failures_and_limits: Initial list validator wrongly assumed BMP-only; it rejected three legitimate selected level-2 Hanzi before TTF generation. Extended the validation and official export range, then all 6500 passed. No selected Hanzi silently removed.
Initial exact-frame equality expectation failed. Preserved and quantified the raster differences; did not relax the exported-glyph coverage or placeholder assertions.

Editor initially reported no target during project load; Ctrl+B loaded the existing target, generated and compiled successfully. An unexpected unsaved leading character was undone; the screen XML has no disk diff. Later UI input/minimize guards were respected; native-size host renders supply visual evidence.
Existing FinSH/linker and generated-file line-ending warnings retained. No hand editing of generated font C, no RLE, no SDK/toolchain/partition/public Build entry change, no cloud baseline.
Both ZIPs preserve recorded sources/artifacts plus generation script/profile/data/license, relevant host test inputs and result.json. Routine artifacts remain local, not committed.

No serial, flash, reboot, RTC or PM action. Device remains on the earlier compass firmware; hardware image decode, glyph appearance, scrolling, wake restoration, frame rate, CPU load and power are unverified.
next_bounded_experiment: Prepare a bounded three-image/common-font display acceptance entry, then bind an operator-confirmed device window and exact new firmware; inspect image/glyph rendering, unsupported-character placeholders, source switching and wake restoration before expanding compression.
